name: poligono-ai-hub
description: Local AI stem separation for audio and video: vocal remover and 4-stem splitter, powered by Demucs v4. Runs entirely on your machine.
author: Polígono Studio

windowsSigningTemplate._comment_1: NOT ACTIVE. electron-builder validates its config with additionalProperties:false at every level, so this block cannot sit commented inside `build`. It lives here, outside anything electron-builder reads, so that turning signing on later is a move rather than a rebuild.
windowsSigningTemplate._comment_2: v1 ships UNSIGNED on purpose. See docs/DISTRIBUTION.md for what SmartScreen shows the customer and what to tell them.
windowsSigningTemplate._comment_3: To enable: move the `azureSignOptions` object below into `build.win`, fill in the three Azure Trusted Signing values, and set the AZURE_TENANT_ID / AZURE_CLIENT_ID / AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET environment variables on the build machine. publisherName must match the certificate exactly. Verified against app-builder-lib 26.4.0 (out/options/winOptions.d.ts).
